options.content:
# Thermostat Fleet — Mixed Billing Mode

Monte Carlo simulation: on-demand for the first third of the simulation, then provisioned capacity with the **right-sizing trap**: provisioned at ~110% of the observed mean, below the morning-spike peak. Throttles appear immediately after the mode switch and disappear after the capacity adjustment at the two-thirds mark.

- Batch ID: `${batch_id}`
- Scenario ID: `${scenarioId}`
- Trial Count: `${trialCount}`
- Simulation Ticks: `${simulationTicks}`
- Window Size (s): `${windowSizeSeconds}`

panels.title: Demo Overview

panels.description: Mean total estimated cost across trials ± one standard deviation.
panels.title: Total Estimated Cost (mean ± stddev)

panels.description: Billing mode per window: 0 = on-demand, 1 = provisioned. Shows the step-function switch at the 1/3-mark and confirms mode remains provisioned for the rest of the simulation.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg("value") as "Billing Mode"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric = 'BillingModeIndicator'
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
  and window_start_tick <= cast('${simulationTicks}' as bigint)
group by window_start_tick
order by window_start_tick;

panels.title: Billing Mode Timeline

panels.description: Throttle rate (throttled requests per second, mean across trials). Spikes after the provisioned mode switch at the 1/3-mark and returns to zero after the capacity adjustment at the 2/3-mark.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg("value") / cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as float) as "Throttle Rate"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric = 'ThrottleCount'
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
  and window_start_tick <= cast('${simulationTicks}' as bigint)
group by window_start_tick
order by window_start_tick;

panels.title: Throttle Rate

panels.description: Admitted vs. throttled requests per time window (mean across trials). Stacked bars show total request volume; the red portion is throttled requests.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg("value") as "Admitted Requests"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric = 'AdmittedRequestCount'
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
  and window_start_tick <= cast('${simulationTicks}' as bigint)
group by window_start_tick
order by window_start_tick;

select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg("value") as "Throttled Requests"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric = 'ThrottleCount'
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
  and window_start_tick <= cast('${simulationTicks}' as bigint)
group by window_start_tick
order by window_start_tick;

panels.title: Admitted vs. Throttled Requests

panels.description: Consumed write capacity distribution (mean, P50, P75, P95 across trials) vs. provisioned ceiling. Bands span P50→P75 (interquartile upper half) and P75→P95 (tail). The mean (white) floats above the median (P50) when alert-storm trials skew the distribution right. If the provisioned line sits below P95 the simulator throttles in ∼5% of trials; below P75, in ∼25%. The right-sizing trap is visible when the mean looks safely below provisioned while P75 or P95 exceeds it.

targets.rawSql:
with perc as (
  select
    window_start_tick,
    avg("value")                                               as mean,
    percentile_cont(0.50) within group (order by "value")     as p50,
    percentile_cont(0.75) within group (order by "value")     as p75,
    percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by "value")     as p95
  from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
  where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
    and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
    and metric = 'WriteCapacityUnits'
    and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
    and window_start_tick <= cast('${simulationTicks}' as bigint)
  group by window_start_tick
)
select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  mean   as "Mean WCU",
  p50    as "P50",
  p75    as "P75",
  p95    as "P95",
  p95    as "Band P95-P75",
  p75    as "Band P75-P50"
from perc
order by window_start_tick;

select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg("value") as "Provisioned WCU"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric = 'ProvisionedWriteCapacityUnits'
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
  and window_start_tick <= cast('${simulationTicks}' as bigint)
group by window_start_tick
order by window_start_tick;

panels.title: Write Capacity: Consumed vs. Provisioned

panels.description: Consumed read capacity vs. provisioned read capacity ceiling per window (mean across trials). Read load is low in this scenario; the provisioned ceiling is generous and no read throttling occurs.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg(case when metric = 'ReadCapacityUnits' then "value" end) as "Consumed RCU",
  avg(case when metric = 'ProvisionedReadCapacityUnits' then "value" end) as "Provisioned RCU"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric in ('ReadCapacityUnits', 'ProvisionedReadCapacityUnits')
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
  and window_start_tick <= cast('${simulationTicks}' as bigint)
group by window_start_tick
order by window_start_tick;

panels.title: Read Capacity: Consumed vs. Provisioned

panels.title: Cumulative Estimated Cost

panels.description: Mean items returned to callers per windowed period, split by operation type (Query vs Scan). In a telemetry-heavy fleet, Scan counts should be visibly lower and less frequent than Query counts. Both series will trend upward as the fleet grows.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg("value") as "Query"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric = 'ReturnedItemCount:Query'
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
group by window_start_tick
order by window_start_tick;

select
  to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg("value") as "Scan"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric = 'ReturnedItemCount:Scan'
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
group by window_start_tick
order by window_start_tick;

panels.title: Returned Item Count by Operation (mean across trials)

targets.rawSql:
select to_timestamp(window_start_tick) as "time",
  avg(case when metric = 'LatencyP50:PutItem' then "value" end) as "P50",
  avg(case when metric = 'LatencyP95:PutItem' then "value" end) as "P95",
  avg(case when metric = 'LatencyP99:PutItem' then "value" end) as "P99"
from stochastacy_demo.trial_window_time_series
where batch_id = '${batch_id}'
  and scenario_id = '${scenarioId}'
  and metric in ('LatencyP50:PutItem', 'LatencyP95:PutItem', 'LatencyP99:PutItem')
  and window_size_seconds = cast('${windowSizeSeconds}' as integer)
group by window_start_tick order by window_start_tick;

panels.title: PutItem Latency Percentiles (ms, mean across trials)
